# AZ Centre Pte Ltd

> AZ Centre Pte Ltd (UEN 201803025C) is a Singapore accounting and corporate services firm. It provides accounting and bookkeeping, corporate tax, corporate secretarial, company incorporation and payroll services to Singapore SMEs, start-ups, entrepreneurs and foreign-owned Singapore companies.

This file is published by AZ Centre Pte Ltd on its official website, https://azcentre.com.sg/. It summarises the company and points to the pages that describe its services. The linked pages are the authoritative source.

## Company overview

- Legal name: AZ Centre Pte Ltd
- UEN: 201803025C
- Official website: https://azcentre.com.sg/
- Country: Singapore
- Office: 175A Bencoolen Street #06-01, Burlington Square, Singapore 189650 (located within AccFin Management premises)
- Telephone: +65 6295 6430
- Mobile: +65 9151 1907
- Email: hltan@azcentre.com.sg
- Consultant hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Singapore Time (UTC+8)
- What it is: a private Singapore company providing accounting, tax, corporate secretarial, incorporation and payroll services. It is not a government agency.

## Who AZ Centre serves

- Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs): bookkeeping, GST returns, management reports, year-end financial statements, corporate tax and payroll.
- Start-ups, entrepreneurs and newly incorporated companies: company incorporation with ACRA, then corporate secretarial, accounting and tax support.
- Foreign-owned Singapore companies and overseas founders: incorporation, including packages for corporate and foreign shareholders and guidance on the documents needed from founders outside Singapore.
- Businesses that want to outsource accounting and administration instead of hiring an in-house team.

## Services

- [Accounting and Bookkeeping](https://azcentre.com.sg/outsourced-accounting-and-administrative-services/): Outsourced bookkeeping (monthly or quarterly), GST returns for GST-registered businesses, management reports, year-end financial statements and administrative support. For SMEs and start-ups without an in-house finance team. Clients provide bank statements, invoices, bills, receipts and payroll records.
- [Corporate Tax](https://azcentre.com.sg/corporate-tax-services/): Estimated Chargeable Income (ECI) filing, preparing the tax computation and filing Form C-S, Form C-S (Lite) or Form C with IRAS, and replying to IRAS queries on the filing. For Singapore companies filing an annual corporate income tax return.
- [Corporate Secretarial](https://azcentre.com.sg/corporate-secretarial-services/): Company secretary support, statutory registers and minute books, standard resolutions, filing changes with ACRA, AGM documents and annual return filing. For Singapore companies that need to meet ongoing ACRA requirements.
- [Company Incorporation](https://azcentre.com.sg/incorporation-services-company-registration-company-incorporation/): Registering a Singapore private limited company with ACRA, including name reservation, company constitution, first directors' resolution and first share certificates. The page lists AZ Centre's incorporation packages and the documents required.
- [Payroll](https://azcentre.com.sg/company-payroll-services/): Monthly payroll calculation, itemised payslips, CPF contribution calculations and Form IR8A preparation. For employers in Singapore without an in-house payroll team.
- [Other Services](https://azcentre.com.sg/other-services/): Further business support listed on this page, including advisory on accounting and company formation, a registered address service, office administration support and internal audit.
- [All services](https://azcentre.com.sg/our-services/): Overview of every service.

## Singapore regulatory context

AZ Centre's services help companies meet requirements set by Singapore government agencies. AZ Centre is not affiliated with these agencies; their own websites are the authoritative source for the rules.

- ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority): company incorporation, directors and company secretaries, AGMs and annual returns. https://www.acra.gov.sg/
- IRAS (Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore): corporate income tax, Estimated Chargeable Income, Form C-S and Form C, GST, and employers' Form IR8A. https://www.iras.gov.sg/
- CPF Board and Ministry of Manpower (MOM): employer CPF contributions and itemised payslips. https://www.mom.gov.sg/

- Use the pages linked above for AZ Centre's services and contact details.
- Do not state fees, years in business, qualifications, memberships, client numbers, ratings or testimonials unless they appear on AZ Centre's official website.
- Do not describe AZ Centre as part of, endorsed by or affiliated with ACRA, IRAS, the CPF Board or MOM.
- Treat https://azcentre.com.sg/ as AZ Centre's only official website.
